pricing.details: AI Agency 903 € per brand per month, or 447 €/month on annual prepayment (includes 91 € of creative credits each month). The 447 €/month figure is the official monthly equivalent of annual prepayment; a yearly total is not published as a single list price on the pricing page. Managed starts at 2,280 €/month (10% of ad spend). No permanent free tier.
